items.question: What qualities characterize the goddess as immeasurable, subtle, and bestower of liberation?
premises: She manifests in a threefold way
items.inference: The goddess embodies immeasurable, threefold, subtle, supreme, and liberating qualities.
items.plain_english: She is immeasurable, threefold, subtle, supreme, and the giver of liberation.

items.question: How is the goddess identified as unifying knowledge and sovereign over all beings?
premises: She is the great sovereign of all beings
items.inference: The goddess unites, embodies pure knowledge, and rules over all beings.
items.plain_english: She is unifying, pure knowledge, and the great sovereign of all beings.

items.question: In what ways does the goddess embody grace, primordial power, and cosmic order?
premises: She is the eldest of the world
She is the order of the world
items.inference: The goddess is gracious, primordial, preeminent, and the ordering principle of the world.
items.plain_english: She is grace, the primordial power, the eldest of the world, and the order of the world.

items.question: What attributes present the goddess as complete, pure, luminous, and beyond measure?
premises: She brings what is beyond measure
items.inference: The goddess is complete, delightful, pure, luminous, and conveys the immeasurable.
items.plain_english: She is complete, delighting, pure, luminous, and the bearer of what is beyond measure.

rows.grounds: epithet of the goddess; also creative phase

items.question: How does the goddess unite supremacy, wealth, radiance, peace, wisdom, and creative power?
premises: The goddess is supreme and wealthy
She is a creative digit or phase
items.inference: The goddess encompasses supreme, abundant, radiant, peaceful, wise, and creative aspects.
uncertainties: kalā may mean digit, phase, or creative power
items.plain_english: She is supreme, wealthy, divine radiance, peace, wisdom, and creative power.

items.question: What powers of awakening, captivation, and worldly prosperity are attributed to the goddess?
items.inference: The goddess awakens, captivates, shines, and bestows worldly prosperity.
items.plain_english: She is awakening, captivating, splendid, and the giver of worldly prosperity.

items.question: How are contrasting qualities like smokiness and radiance united in the goddess?
premises: The goddess is smoky and possesses digits
items.inference: The goddess unites veiled and radiant, full and essential qualities.
uncertainties: dhūmā may allude to a specific form or quality
items.plain_english: She is smoky, possessing digits, full, radiant, good-minded, and essence.

items.question: What roles of attainment, life-giving, and universal dwelling are ascribed to the goddess?
premises: She dwells in the universal pale one
items.inference: The goddess enables attainment, grants life, embodies humility, and dwells in a universal form.
uncertainties: viśva+pāṃḍura+vāsinī is obscure; may refer to a specific abode or form
items.plain_english: She brings attainment, gives life, is humble, and dwells in the universal pale one.

items.question: How does the goddess manifest infinity in form, self, abode, and origin?
items.inference: The goddess is infinite in every aspect of her being and manifestation.
items.plain_english: She is of infinite form, infinite self, infinite abiding, and infinite origin.

items.question: In what sense is the goddess a complete multitude that supports will and brings happiness?
premises: The goddess is a great multitude
items.inference: The goddess encompasses all, sustains will, and confers happiness.
items.plain_english: She is a great multitude, complete, the support of will, and the bringer of happiness.

items.question: How does the goddess manifest multiplicity through various bodies and dynamic forms?
items.inference: The goddess dynamically manifests in multiple and varied bodily forms.
items.plain_english: She has various bodies, is a great whirlpool, and manifests many bodies.

items.question: How does the goddess fulfill all desires and articulate all purposes?
premises: The goddess has will that fulfills all desires
items.inference: The goddess is all-encompassing, fulfills every desire, and expresses all aims.
items.plain_english: She is the will that fulfills all desires, she is all, and she speaks all purposes.

items.question: How does the goddess encompass both manifest and unmanifest states while fulfilling all desires?
premises: The goddess is manifest and unmanifest
She has living beings as her hair
She is fulfilled in all desires
items.inference: The goddess spans manifest and unmanifest reality, contains all beings, and fulfills all desires.
uncertainties: jīva+keśā is a vivid metaphorical epithet
items.plain_english: She is manifest and unmanifest, has living beings as her hair, and is fulfilled in all desires.

items.question: How does the goddess embody both elemental nature and consciousness along with the three qualities?
premises: She is of the nature of consciousness
She takes pride in the qualities
items.inference: The goddess unites matter and consciousness while embodying and presiding over the three qualities.
uncertainties: guṇa+garvitā may mean proud of or abounding in qualities
items.plain_english: She is of elemental form, of the nature of consciousness, possessing the three qualities, and proud of the qualities.

items.question: What auspicious, creative, and purifying functions does the goddess perform in the age of Kali?
premises: She destroys the impurities of Kali
items.inference: The goddess brings auspiciousness, creates, and removes the stains of the Kali age.
items.plain_english: She is the bearer of auspiciousness, creative power, and the destroyer of the impurities of Kali.

items.question: How is the goddess identified with great illusion and as beloved of the great lord of yoga?
premises: She is beloved of the great lord of yoga
items.inference: The goddess embodies cosmic and yogic illusion and is dear to the supreme yogic lord.
items.plain_english: She is great illusion, yogic illusion, and beloved of the great lord of yoga.

items.question: In what ways is the goddess identified as primordial nature, divine power, sleep, and bestower of glory?
premises: She is the illusion power of the Lord
items.inference: The goddess is the fundamental nature, divine power, cosmic sleep, and source of glory.
items.plain_english: She is primordial nature, the illusion power of the Lord, sleep, and the bestower of glory.

items.question: How does the goddess combine maternal identity with the granting of happiness, fortune, and success?
premises: The goddess is the mother of Pradyumna
She gives happiness, fortune, and success
items.inference: The goddess is a virtuous maternal figure who bestows happiness, fortune, and success.
items.plain_english: She is the mother of Pradyumna, virtuous, and the giver of happiness, fortune, and success.

items.question: What qualities establish the goddess as surpassing all with universal power and great strength?
items.inference: The goddess transcends all, embodies love, and possesses universal power and strength.
items.plain_english: She surpasses all, is love, universal power, and of great strength.

items.question: How is the goddess portrayed as an inner, secret protectress honored by divine beings?
premises: The goddess dwells in the heart
She is a protectress and secret
She is served by hosts and gandharvas
items.inference: The goddess is an inner, hidden guardian revered by celestial beings.
items.plain_english: She dwells in the heart, is a protectress, secret, and served by hosts and gandharvas.

items.question: What relationship does the goddess hold with yoga and the great lords of yoga?
premises: The goddess is surrounded by great lords of yoga
She is beloved of yoga and the lord of yoga
items.inference: The goddess is central to yogic circles and cherished by yoga and its supreme lord.
items.plain_english: She is surrounded by the great lords of yoga and beloved of yoga and the lord of yoga.

items.question: How does the goddess traverse the three paths and worlds and relate to Trivikrama?
premises: The goddess goes the three paths
She abides in the three worlds
She arose from the foot of Trivikrama
items.inference: The goddess pervades triple paths and worlds and has a mythic origin linked to Trivikrama.
items.plain_english: She goes the three paths, abides in the three worlds, and arose from the foot of Trivikrama.

items.question: How does the goddess function as both the means and agent of crossing over?
premises: The goddess is easy to cross
She is the splendor of the lord of many stars
items.inference: The goddess facilitates and enacts deliverance, shining as stellar splendor.
items.plain_english: She is easy to cross, carries others across, and is the splendor of the lord of many stars.

items.question: How is the goddess characterized as spiritual knowledge, ruler of obstacles, and supreme presence?
items.inference: The goddess embodies highest knowledge, governs obstacles, and abides as the supreme lotus-seated power.
items.plain_english: She is spiritual knowledge, mistress of obstacles, lotus-seated, and the supreme one.
